scheme_name: The Tripura Tribal Folk Arts & Cultural (Financial Assistance) Rules, 2022
other_conditions: Applicants must be individuals or organizations belonging to Scheduled Tribes and engaged in promoting and preserving tribal culture.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to 15% above previous year's expenditure for government-level events and up to 10% for NGOs, with a maximum of ₹30,000 per new application.
